name: Couches & sofas
publicNote: Includes sectionals and sleeper sofas. Tell us about tight stairways or doorways.

name: Recliners & armchairs
publicNote: Power recliners included — mention if it has a battery pack.

name: Tables & chairs
publicNote: Dining sets, coffee tables, patio sets.

name: Dressers, cabinets & bookcases
publicNote: Please empty drawers before pickup.

name: Entertainment centers & armoires
publicNote: Large pieces may need to be disassembled to fit through doorways.

name: Mattresses & box springs
publicNote: Any size. Let us know about bed bugs in advance so we can plan handling.
notes: Owner to confirm bed-bug infested mattress policy.

name: Bed frames & headboards
publicNote: Metal and wood frames, bunk beds, daybeds.

name: Adjustable bed bases
publicNote: Powered bases are heavy and have motors — describe the model when you call.

name: Washers & dryers
publicNote: Disconnect power and water ahead of time if you can, and drain the washer. Gas dryers must be disconnected by a qualified person.

name: Stoves, ovens & ranges
publicNote: Gas ranges must be disconnected and capped by a qualified person before pickup.

name: Dishwashers
publicNote: Uninstalled units are simplest. Ask us if it is still plumbed in.
notes: Owner to confirm whether crew disconnects installed dishwashers.

name: Water heaters
publicNote: Must be drained and disconnected before pickup.

name: Refrigerators & freezers
publicNote: These contain refrigerant, so we confirm handling before scheduling. Empty and defrost first.
notes: Owner must confirm downstream refrigerant-recovery outlet.

name: Window AC units & dehumidifiers
publicNote: Contain refrigerant — call first so we can confirm.

name: Microwaves & small kitchen appliances
publicNote: Toasters, mixers, coffee makers, and similar.

name: Boxes, bags & general clutter
publicNote: Bagged or boxed household items. Do not include food waste or liquids.

name: Clothing, linens & textiles
publicNote: Bag them so they are easy to carry.

name: Toys, décor & housewares
publicNote: Includes children's play sets that are already disassembled.

name: Carpet & rugs
publicNote: Rolled carpet and padding are easiest to load.

name: Exercise equipment
publicNote: Treadmills, ellipticals, and weight machines are heavy — tell us the model and where it sits.

name: Pianos
publicNote: Call us to discuss — we need details before we can confirm.
notes: Owner to confirm piano removal capability.

name: Grills & patio furniture
publicNote: Remove propane tanks first — we do not take propane cylinders.

name: Bicycles, hand tools & shelving
publicNote: Empty gas-powered tools of fuel before pickup.

name: Lawn mowers & gas-powered equipment
publicNote: Fuel and oil must be drained before pickup.

name: Yard waste & branches
publicNote: Call to check. City of Mobile residents may also have a separate trash and limb collection option.
notes: Owner to confirm yard debris policy.

name: Hot tubs & spas
publicNote: Call us to discuss — not confirmed yet.
notes: Owner to confirm hot tub removal.

name: Drywall, lumber & trim
publicNote: Non-hazardous remodel debris. Remove nails where practical and tell us roughly how much.

name: Cabinets, doors & fixtures
publicNote: Removed cabinets, vanities, toilets, and doors.

name: Tile, brick & concrete
publicNote: Very heavy. Small amounts are usually fine — describe the volume so we can confirm.

name: Roofing shingles
publicNote: Call to check before scheduling.

name: Office desks, chairs & cubicles
publicNote: Cubicle systems may need disassembly time — mention it when you call.

name: File cabinets
publicNote: Please remove files first. We do not provide document shredding.

name: Shelving & store fixtures
publicNote: Gondola shelving and displays — tell us the quantity.

name: Desktop computers & towers
publicNote: Back up and erase your data first. Removing the hard drive yourself is also an option.

name: Laptops & notebooks
publicNote: Batteries must be intact — no swelling, cracks, or leaks.

name: Keyboards, mice & webcams
publicNote: Remove loose batteries from wireless devices.

name: Flat-panel computer monitors
publicNote: LCD and LED monitors. Cracked screens: let us know in advance.

name: Flat-screen TVs
publicNote: Tell us the screen size and type when you call so we can confirm.
notes: Owner must confirm TV acceptance by type.

name: CRT (tube) TVs & monitors
publicNote: Older tube TVs need owner approval before pickup. Please call first.
notes: CRTs contain leaded glass; downstream outlet must be confirmed.

name: Projection & console TVs
publicNote: Large and heavy — call first so we can check.

name: Printers & scanners
publicNote: Home and office printers. Remove paper; ink and toner cartridges can stay installed.
notes: Some multifunction printers store scanned documents.

name: Office copiers & large multifunction devices
publicNote: Floor-standing copiers are heavy. Check your lease first — leased units usually go back to the leasing company.

name: Cell phones & smartphones
publicNote: Factory reset, sign out of accounts, and remove SIM and memory cards first. Battery must be intact.

name: Tablets & e-readers
publicNote: Same preparation as phones. Swollen devices cannot be picked up.

name: Servers & rack equipment
publicNote: Tell us quantity, rack size, and whether drives have been removed or wiped.
notes: UPS units contain lead-acid batteries — confirm separately.

name: Routers, modems & network switches
publicNote: Return rented ISP equipment to your provider instead — it is usually their property.

name: UPS battery backups
publicNote: Contain sealed lead-acid or lithium batteries. Call first so we can confirm handling.

name: Game consoles & controllers
publicNote: Sign out of your gaming accounts and remove discs first.

name: Stereos, speakers, receivers & DVD players
publicNote: Home audio and video components.

name: Cables, cords & wires
publicNote: Bag or box them together.

name: Chargers & power adapters
publicNote: Wall chargers and laptop power bricks. Power banks count as batteries — see below.

name: Small electronics
publicNote: Digital cameras, radios, landline phones, and similar. Remove loose batteries.

name: Loose household batteries & power banks
publicNote: Not mixed into a junk load. Call first — we will confirm handling or point you to a drop-off option. Tape terminals of lithium batteries.
notes: Owner to confirm whether intact loose batteries are accepted.

name: Swollen, damaged or leaking batteries
publicNote: Fire risk. Do not put them in household trash. Contact your local household hazardous waste program.

name: Car & lead-acid batteries
publicNote: Call to check. Auto parts retailers commonly accept them.

name: Paint, solvents & chemicals
publicNote: Includes pesticides, pool chemicals, and automotive fluids.

name: Propane tanks & fuel cylinders
publicNote: Includes camping fuel and helium tanks.

name: Asbestos & suspected asbestos materials
publicNote: Requires licensed abatement.

name: Medical waste & sharps
publicNote: Needles, biohazards, and prescription medications.

name: Tires
publicNote: Call to check before including tires.
notes: Owner to confirm tire policy and any disposal fees.

name: Gasoline, oil & fuel containers
publicNote: Includes full or partly full gas cans.
